response.justification: While Bogdan is an accomplished software engineer with 15+ years of diverse experience, he is fundamentally misaligned with this embedded security role. He lacks three critical required qualifications: native-level Japanese proficiency, strong C programming expertise (his background is exclusively web/full-stack in TypeScript/Node.js), and any professional experience in networking or security technologies. His entire career trajectory—from web platforms to GIS applications to AI infrastructure—shows zero progression toward embedded firmware, LAN-switch products, or security domains. The comprehensive gap across required technical skills, domain knowledge, and language requirements makes him unsuitable despite his general engineering competence.
strengths: Extensive 15+ years of software development experience across multiple languages and domains, well exceeding minimum requirements
Demonstrated ability to rapidly acquire new technologies and programming languages with successful deliverables in diverse technical environments
Strong software craftsmanship practices including testing, CI/CD pipelines, and maintainable architecture design
concerns: Does not possess native-level Japanese language proficiency, stated as a required qualification for this role
Primary programming expertise in high-level languages (TypeScript, Node.js); no demonstrated strong C proficiency or embedded systems development background
Zero professional experience in networking, security technologies, embedded firmware, or LAN-switch products; career exclusively focused on web, mobile, and full-stack services
